blocks.text: LIST OF COUNCIL OF MINISTERS AS ON 6TH AUGUST, 1990.

blocks.html:
1. Shri Vishwanath Pratap SinghPrime Minister and also incharge of the Ministries/ Departments of Defence; Personnel; Public Grievances and Pensions; Science & Technology; Atomic Energy; Electronics; Ocean Development; Space and other subjects not allocated to any other Cabinet Minister or Minister of State (Independent charge).
2. Prof. Madhu DandavateMinister of Finance.
3. Shri Mufti Mohammad SayeedMinister of Home Affairs.
4. Shri Ajit SinghMinister of Industry.
5. Shri Arun Kumar NehruMinister of Commerce and Tourism.
6. Shri I.K. GujralMinister of External Affairs.
7. Shri George FernandesMinister of Railways.
8. Shri Sharad YadavMinister of Textiles with additional charge of the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.
9. Shri Arif Mohd. KhanMinister of Energy with additional charge of the Ministry of Civil Aviation.
10. Shri M.S. GurupadaswamyMinister of Petroleum and Chemicals.
11. Shri K.P. UnnikrishnanMinister of Surface Transport.
12. Shri Dinesh GoswamiMinister of Steel and Mines with additional charge of the Ministry of Law and Justice.
13. Shri Murasoli MaranMinister of Urban Development.
14. Shri Nathu Ram MirdhaMinister of Food and Civil Supplies.
15. Shri Nilamani RoutrayMinister of Environment and Forests.
